brief:
The Latin Patriarchate of Jerusalem held a solemn Holy Mass for the Solemnity of All Saints at the Monastery of the Poor Claires, presided over by H.B. Cardinal Pierbattista Pizzaballa, Latin Patriarch of Jerusalem. The liturgy marked the closure of the diocesan phase of a canonization cause.

The celebration brought together the faithful to honor all saints on the feast day dedicated to their memory, with the patriarch leading the solemn observance at the monastery.

title: Cardinal Pizzaballa presides over All Saints Mass in Jerusalem
